title: Time will tell if Jaxson Dart’s injury sinks Giants’ season, or they survive

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Time will tell if Jaxson Dart’s injury sinks Giants’ season, or they survive
sources.description: This was supposed to be a Monday night statement — a chance for the Giants to show their season-opener was no admiration and they had arrived. Instead, seven plays into their clash with the Super Bowl favorite Rams, it all ended.
